text: しあわせそうに　みえるわ　グリーンにも　みならって　ほしい　くらいね

structure.jp: しあわせそうに　みえるわ
グリーンにも　みならって　ほしい
structure.en: I want Green too to follow your example

patterns.name: 〜てほしい
patterns.span: みならって　ほしい
patterns.explanation: ほしい after a て-form means you want someone else to do it; that person takes に. グリーンにも　みならって　ほしい = 'I want Green too to copy you'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.span: しあわせそうに　みえる
patterns.explanation: そう added to a describing word means 'looks like it is'; with に it tells how it appears. しあわせそうに　みえる = 'it looks happy'.

patterns.name: 〜くらい
patterns.span: みならって　ほしい　くらい
patterns.explanation: くらい after a phrase means 'so much that' that phrase is true. みならって　ほしい　くらい = 'so much that I'd want him to copy you'.
